subject: Specify a user provided tag instead of the default XT

messages.author: a850b849a51d3d6a
messages.subject: Specify a user provided tag instead of the default XT
parts:
Hi Wei,

Thank you very much for this fantastic tool! It saves me much time.

I noticed that if I first run featureCounts and output a bam file, and then run featureCounts again using the output bam file as the input, a single alignment could have two 'XT' tags. Therefore, I cannot distinguish the tag from the first run and the second run. So I'm wondering if it is possible to specify a user-provided tag instead of the default 'XT' tag.

Thank you very much!
